draft_en.subject: The 8-port PoE switch sold with XBLUE systems - a second ODM source
draft_en.body:
Hi Paul,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 18 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the 8-port PoE switch sold with XBLUE phone systems (ONV-built today, by the look of it), a second ODM source in XBLUE packaging from small lots, FCC/CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed with VLAN and QoS for voice, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); for the plain unmanaged position, 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit uplinks - STC-028GP - $27.2.

One question: what annual volume does that SKU run at - that decides whether the XBLUE carton comes from the first lot?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
